answer_1.quote: We propose AutoGUI, a scalable and automatic annotation pipeline aimed to produce massive UI element functionality annotations used to enhance UI grounding capabilities of VLMs.
answer_1.outputs: functionality descriptions of UI elements based on visual and structural changes

answer_2.quote: We report the grounding accuracy (%): Acc = N i=1 1 (pred i inside GT bbox i ) /N × 100 where 1 is an indicator function and N is the number of test samples.

answer_3.quote: To improve dataset quality, we prompt LLMs to verify the annotations, inspired by works that justify the feasibility of LLM-based verification.

answer_4.quote: The authors rigorously evaluate the annotation results based on (a) AutoGUI (c) Widget Captioning (b) SeeClick Web three criteria outlined in Fig. I.
answer_4.guideline: Three specific criteria outlined in Fig I were provided to ensure clarity and correctness of annotations, including how to assess element functionality based on UI content changes and how to identify invalid samples.
